Ex-Sumo Group CEO Carl Cavers joins co-dev studio Vertpaint as non-exec director and shareholder

Co-development studio Vertpaint has appointed former Sumo Group co-founder and CEO Carl Cavers OBE as non-executive director and shareholder.

FirstLook launches creator-first platform Creators.gg with launch partners IO Interactive and Brain Jar Games

Player relationship and marketing platform FirstLook has launched Creators.gg to connect studios with creators of any size, rather than limiting opportunities to those with the largest audiences.

Atari's core business returns to profit, but consolidated group posts $5.5m net loss as Thunderful drags on results

Atari has released its consolidated financial results for the full 2025-26 fiscal year, reporting revenue growth of 66% year-on-year to $65 million (€56.0 million), its highest level in more than a decade, driven largely by the acquisition of Swedish publisher Thunderful and continued growth across its Games and Hardware lines.
